summary: Verified both bug fixes end-to-end. (1) Destination search on booking wizard step 3 now returns suggestions for 'mumbai' (Chhatrapati Shivaji, Juhu Aerodrome, Kokilaben, Reliance Corporate Park, Pawan Hans, NSCI Dome — matches backend total=8) and 'delhi' (Indira Gandhi, AIIMS Trauma, Fortis Escorts, Safdarjung, IGI Airport T3 — backend total=6); dropdown appears and items are selectable. (2) Login OTP is globally disabled — all 4 roles (customer, admin, operator, ceo) log in with a single POST /api/auth/login (no otp_required in response) and land directly on their respective dashboards with no Security Verification screen. Regression: customer, admin, operator, ceo dashboards render normally, confirming DB_NAME=airyatra_db switch did not break core flows.

issues: Departure Date and Pickup Time use browser-native <input type=date>/<time> pickers (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn Calendar/Time components used elsewhere in the app — inconsistent UX. Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: LandingPointSelector.handleSearch swallows errors silently (console.error only) — consider surfacing a toast so users know when the search API fails.

GET /api/landing/public/search returns a mixed shape (legacy landing_points collection docs and newer operator-created docs with different field names such as landing_point_name vs name, rent_per_landing vs rent). Frontend already normalizes on `name`, but consolidating this at the API layer would reduce fragility.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded landing points and pre-provisioned test accounts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Booking flow is a 4-step wizard. To reach the LandingPointSelector (destination search) you MUST advance through Step 1 (select aircraft type Helicopter/Chartered Plane) and Step 2 (select Booking Type card, plus Flight Type + Booking For + Booking Purpose dropdowns) — none of these can be skipped or the wizard blocks progression. The two search inputs (Pickup + Drop) appear only on Step 3 with placeholder 'Search city, airport, helipad... / शहर, एयरपोर्ट खोजें...'. Backend search endpoint returns an object {landing_points:[...], total:N}, NOT a bare array. LOGIN_OTP_ENABLED='false' in backend/.env is what disables OTP globally via auth_routes.py — do NOT flip it.
rca_of_the_issue: Bug 1: previous DB_NAME='airyatra' had 0 landing_points, so public search returned an empty landing_points array and the frontend dropdown never opened (renders only when searchResults.length > 0). Fix was flipping DB_NAME to 'airyatra_db' which contains 73 seeded landing points. Bug 2: env var LOGIN_OTP_ENABLED='false' short-circuits the OTP branch in auth_routes.py (~line 450) forcing requires_otp=False for all users, so /api/auth/login always returns access_token directly.
